question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of recycled materials out of the total product mass in relation to recycled materials?
data_point: mass fraction of recycled materials out of the total product mass
description: Fraction of mass of a product from recycled sources (FR) refers to the mass fraction of recycled materials out of the total product mass in relation to recycled materials.
